scripts.dev: bunx concurrently --kill-others -n core,server,desktop -c blue,green,yellow 'bun run dev:core' 'bun run dev:server' 'bun run dev:desktop'
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/server build && bun run --cwd packages/desktop build && bun run --cwd packages/webapp build
scripts.build:cli: bun run --cwd packages/webapp build && bun run --cwd packages/core build && NEXT_STANDALONE=1 bun run --cwd packages/server build && node scripts/stage-cli-runtime.mjs && bun run --cwd packages/cli build
scripts.pack:cli: npm run build:cli && npm run pack:cloudflared && npm pack ./packages/cli --pack-destination packages/cli --ignore-scripts --workspaces=false && node scripts/audit-cli-tarball.mjs packages/cli/agentroam-0.2.0-preview.4.tgz
